meta.title: System Initialization Tasks To Process
meta.description:
A set tasks defined within the module are loaded into the pending list.

Each task defines a command and the conditions that satisfy its completion, which is typically a single event.

By convention, each module's final task should be a system initialization finalization task.

meta.title: {Do Task}
meta.description:
This is left generic, because it depends on the tasks that need to done for the system being designed.

But this is typically where I typically have many tasks, that define permissions, define roles, and grant permissions to roles.
